title: A New Expression of Alpine Living: PCPD and Hyatt Unveil ONE HANAZONO VILLAS in Niseko, Japan
summary: CHICAGO (September 1, 2026) – Set in the heart of Niseko, Japan’s renowned ski destination, within the celebrated Hanazono landscape, Pacific Century Premium Developments Limited (“PCPD,”...
body_markdown:
**CHICAGO (September 1, 2026)** – Set in the heart of Niseko, Japan’s renowned ski destination, within the celebrated Hanazono landscape, Pacific Century Premium Developments Limited (“PCPD,” SEHK: 00432) and Hyatt Hotels Corporation (NYSE: H) today announced ONE HANAZONO VILLAS, a curated collection of 13 private residences that will become the first Park Hyatt-branded villas in Japan. Bringing together the architectural vision of Kengo Kuma, interiors by André Fu and service by the Park Hyatt Niseko Hanazono team, the development introduces a new expression of refined alpine living shaped by privacy, design and effortless immersion in the natural landscape.


Positioned across an elevated site, each grand scale villa offers generous living spaces crafted for refined indulgence across every season. Owners will have exclusive access to a private clubhouse* offering ski‑in, ski‑out connectivity to the slopes and dedicated lounge for après-ski relaxation and gathering. Managed and serviced by the Park Hyatt Niseko Hanazono team, the residences will combine the independence of private ownership with personalized service and management expertise upheld by the Park Hyatt brand.


Spanning approximately 700 to 1,000 square meters (7,500 to 10,400 square feet), each individually separated villa features four to six ensuite bedrooms, expansive living and dining space designed for refined comfort for year-round residence. Most villas enjoy panoramic views of the iconic Mount Yotei, offering breathtaking scenery across all four seasons. Two exquisitely furnished show villas are scheduled for completion this winter.


“PCPD is committed to creating high-quality, visionary developments that combine luxury with sustainable excellence,” said Mr. Benjamin Lam, PCPD’s Deputy Chairman and Group Managing Director. “Inspired by the warm reception of Park Hyatt Niseko Hanazono and its residences, which launched and opened in 2020, we are delighted to deepen our longstanding relationship with Hyatt through ONE HANAZONO VILLAS, to be crafted as works of art to be cherished and passed down through generations.”


Mr. Benjamin Lam added, “This milestone marks a step forward in our vision for Niseko, Japan. It also underscores our shared commitment to thoughtful design and refined residential living, while reinforcing Hanazono’s position as the premier alpine destination in Asia. With the distinction of ski-in, ski-out access, a rarity not only in Niseko but also globally, ONE HANAZONO VILLAS represents an offering of exceptional exclusivity.”


“We are pleased to collaborate with PCPD on ONE HANAZONO VILLAS as an extension of our Park Hyatt residences portfolio, built on a strong alignment of vision and expertise,” said Stephen Ho, President - Greater China and Growth, Asia Pacific, Hyatt. “We continue to see strong demand from discerning buyers for residential offerings that bring together outstanding design, personalized service and a greater sense of space and discretion. ONE HANAZONO VILLAS reflects that vision through a limited collection of individually separated residences supported by the expertise associated with the Park Hyatt brand.”


“ONE HANAZONO VILLAS represents a meaningful expansion of Hyatt’s residential portfolio,” said Tina Necrason, Global Head of Branded Residential, Hyatt. “With only 13 individually separated villas in one of the world’s most celebrated alpine destinations, the development brings together distinctive design, personalized service and the freedom of private residential living. We are grateful to PCPD and the Park Hyatt Niseko Hanazono team for bringing this vision to life.”


Contemporary sophistication will meet panoramic views of Mount Yotei at the villas, which will feature private driveways and a secluded garden sanctuary, all nestled in the lush surroundings. Family memories and curated experiences await for those privileged few who will call this home.


PCPD has played a central role in the long-term evolution of Niseko as a world-class ski destination, anchored by its development of premium hospitality, residential and resort infrastructure in Hanazono. Its portfolio in Hanazono and Weiss spans more than 2.7 million square meters (29 million square feet), reflecting a continues commitment to thoughtfully planned destinations and integrated communities.


*The term* *“Hyatt” is used in this release for convenience to refer to Hyatt Hotels Corporation and/or one or more of its affiliates.*


– END


**About PCPD**


Pacific Century Premium Developments Limited (“PCPD” or the “Group”, SEHK: 00432) is principally engaged in the development and management of premium-grade property and infrastructure projects as well as premium-grade property investments. PCCW Limited (“PCCW”, SEHK: 00008) is the single largest shareholder of the Group.


**About Park Hyatt**


Park Hyatt’s legacy spans over 45 years of being the luxury choice for discerning global travelers, offering refined and exceptional accommodations in the world’s most desirable cities and resort destinations. Each property is thoughtfully designed to deliver residentially inspired elegance through architecture, housed world-class art, and curated immersive culinary experiences—all complemented by an intuitively personalized level of service. Guests enjoy carefully appointed rooms, acclaimed design, and signature restaurants led by award-winning chefs—creating experiences as personal as they are memorable. For more information, visit parkhyatt.com. Follow @ParkHyatt on Facebook and Instagram, and tag your moments with #LuxuryIsPersonal.


**About Hyatt Hotels Corporation**


Hyatt Hotels Corporation, headquartered in Chicago, is a leading global hospitality company guided by its purpose – to care for people so they can be their best. As of June 30, 2026, the Company's portfolio included more than 1,500 hotels and all-inclusive properties in 83 countries across six continents. The Company's offering includes brands in the Luxury Portfolio, including Park Hyatt®, Alila®, Miraval®, Impression by Secrets, and The Unbound Collection by Hyatt®; the Lifestyle Portfolio, including Andaz®, Thompson Hotels®, The Standard®, Dream® Hotels, The StandardX®, Breathless Resorts & Spas®, JdV by Hyatt®, Bunkhouse® Hotels, and Me and All Hotels; the Inclusive Collection, including Zoëtry® Wellness & Spa Resorts, Hyatt Ziva®, Hyatt Zilara®, Secrets® Resorts & Spas, Dreams® Resorts & Spas, Hyatt Vivid® Hotels & Resorts, Bahia Principe Hotels & Resorts, Alua Hotels & Resorts®, and Sunscape® Resorts & Spas; the Classics Portfolio, including Grand Hyatt®, Hyatt Regency®, Destination by Hyatt®, Hyatt Centric®, Hyatt Vacation Club®, and Hyatt®; and the Essentials Portfolio, including Caption by Hyatt®, Unscripted by Hyatt, Hyatt Place®, Hyatt House®, Hyatt Studios®, Hyatt Select, and UrCove. Subsidiaries of the Company operate the World of Hyatt® loyalty program, ALG Vacations®, Mr & Mrs Smith, Unlimited Vacation Club®, Amstar® DMC destination management services, and Trisept Solutions® technology services. For more information, please visit[www.hyatt.com](http://www.hyatt.com/) .
